scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Meet the Funeral Expenses of Differently Abled Person
other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir of the differently abled person
The differently abled person must be deceased
The differently abled person must have been a registered member of the Welfare Board for the Differently Abled
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 is provided to the legal heir of the deceased differently abled person to meet funeral expenses.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
